```yaml
name: CI - Lazer Sui Contract

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ci-lazer-sui-contract.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ci-lazer-sui-contract.yml'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Sui CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MystenLabs/sui/main/dotenv/.env -o .env
          source .env
          SUI_VERSION=${SUI_VERSION:-1.32.0}
          curl -L "https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/mainnet/sui-${SUI_VERSION}-ubuntu-x86_64.tgz" | tar -xvz
          sudo mv sui-${SUI_VERSION}-ubuntu-x86_64/sui /usr/local/bin/
          sui --version

      - name: Run Sui Move Tests
        working-directory: lazer/contracts/sui
        run: sui move test
```
